name: Coremax Corporation
summary: Coremax Corporation engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of metal-based specialty chemicals and battery materials in Taiwan. The company provides catalysts in liquid form, including prime cobalt acetate, manganese acetate, cobalt manganese acetate, cobalt manganese bromide, cobalt bromide, manganese bromide, and regenerated cobalt manganese bromide solutions; and in crystalline forms, such as cobalt acetate and manganese acetate. It also offers specialty chemicals and battery materials comprising cobalt hydroxide, cobalt and manganese acetate, cobalt oxide, electronic and industrial grade sulfuric acid, ITO etching, Cr etching, nickel sulfate, oxalic acid, and tin…
